_comment: Whitelist of parameters the AI advisor is allowed to propose changes to. Anything outside this list falls back to an anomaly callout — never auto-applied. Loaded by claude_advisor.py at startup. PR additions here when you want to expose a new tunable to Claude.
_format: Each entry has scope (device|global), min, max (inclusive bounds enforced server-side at apply time), and an optional comment for human reviewers + the advisor's prompt context.

smart_charge.max_charge_w.comment: Maximum AC charge wattage the smart-charge controller will pull from the grid via the Kasa plug.

smart_charge.target_sunrise_soc_pct.comment: Target SOC at sunrise — controller grid-charges overnight to hit this.

smart_charge.max_on_duration_minutes.comment: Hard cap on a single AC charging window so a forecasting bug can't lock the plug on indefinitely.
